script: "Pat betrayed my love; I planned revenge that turned my life upside down.". I had a friend named Pat who was fine until college. He started acting like a control freak, telling me what boyfriend to dump, what class to take, who to hang with. I ignored him, moved off campus, and found a house with two great friends. It worked until they left, so I started looking for new roommates on campus. Pat was mad I wasn't on campus, even though I had my own space and needed it. He started stalking my roommate search, painting me as a drama queen on a private message board. I was livid. I had no enemies, but he had a public "live journal" where he bragged about selling booze and drugs to students he was supposed to oversee as an RA. I sent that journal to the head of residential life. Pat lost his RA job a month before classes started. He had a month to find a new place, but he couldn't be in a position of authority. I told him, "I'll treat you the way you treat me." He stopped talking to me, probably because he knew I'd seen his journal. He tried to sabotage my living situation, and I returned the favor. The audacity, bestie.
